briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 accelerate multi-agent deployments amid rising injection risks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on agentic systems with o4 and R2 leading adoption. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny intensify as deployment scales. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration while DeepSeek releases R2 claiming parity on coding benchmarks. Anthropic and Google push Claude 4 and Gemini 3 previews. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 weights. xAI scales Grok-3 training cluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New research highlights persistent prompt injection vectors in agent swarms. Regulators draft mandatory red-teaming rules for frontier models. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA and AMD. Microsoft and Google announce new 1GW data center campuses in Texas and Arizona. Stargate supercluster reaches 200k H100 equivalent.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all multi-agent deployments by 2028?
